claims: HBO is developing a new Harry Potter live-action television series.
The Harry Potter live-action television series is set to premiere around Christmas 2026 or 2027.
The first season of the Harry Potter television series is anticipated for Christmas 2026 or 2027.
The Harry Potter television series will be a decade-long adaptation of J.K. Rowling’s seven books.
Each season of the Harry Potter television series will cover one novel.
The Harry Potter television series will feature an entirely new cast.
The Harry Potter television series is designed for the Max streaming service.
Francesca Gardiner (Succession) will be the showrunner.
Mark Mylod (Game of Thrones) will direct multiple episodes.
A new cast for the Harry Potter television series is underway.
Recent announcements include Dominic McLaughlin as Harry.
Recent announcements include Arabella Stanton as Hermione.
Recent announcements include Alastair Stout as Ron.
Other reported roles include Anjula Murali as Padma Patil.
Other reported roles include Oliver Croft as Marcus Flint.
The Harry Potter television series is designed to run for 10 years.
J.K. Rowling will serve as an executive producer.
